issues: Sales fell by £5,316.63 week on week but beat target by £2,004.38, and were up year on year (SJQ GM/HC meeting and KPI meeting 10/11).
Covers fell by 425, mostly in quieter weekday lunches, while spend per head rose to £22.57 thanks to team incentives, beating the £22 target.
Wages were 20.8% and food cost 22.67%; the efficiency score was 100 and the budget rota targets were met (KPI meeting 10/11).

Best sellers were Steak Tataki Ramen (479 including 3 halal), Chicken Ramen (366) and Black Garlic Tonkotsu (302); the weakest were steak tataki nigiri and surf clam nigiri (1 each) and surf clam sashimi (2) (SJQ GM/HC meeting).
Drinks hit the 10% sales mix target, but sushi (20% target) and sides (13.5% target) did not, although sides improved (SJQ GM/HC meeting).
More hours were used than the week before but the wage target was hit, with a labour split of 43.92% FOH and 56.08% BOH against a 45% and 55% target (SJQ GM/HC meeting).

Food usage variance was minus 0.1% and wet usage variance 4.6%; the drinks variance was slightly high because recipe ingredients were missing for the Yuzu Matcha specials, which have now been updated.
Google reviews: eleven 5 star and one 4 star.
Loyalty member bills were down, while free birthday ramens were redeemed often (KPI meeting 10/11).

Weekly hygiene compliance was 100% and site compliance 99%; the site is waiting on Peter Brown for the fire safety risk assessment certificate through Reese, with pest control and fire alarm checks coming up.
Maintenance: the grease trap pump is underpowered and overflows when the ramen cooker is drained, and the site is waiting for Ross to provide a fix.
St James management is making it hard to get permits for contractors Chris (LED screen installation) and Reese (fire panel service) (KPI meeting 10/11).
Staffing: two team members leave in December, a BOH team member is away for a month in December so sushi cover is needed for the first two weeks, and an FOH team member is taking a two week holiday.
Cash collection from the previous week failed because the cash deposit limit was reached, so a new account and a higher limit are being set up (Admin Meeting 09/11).
Promotions: books in stock to buy, XOXO cocktails, the Maki app, Christmas specials (excluding apple gyoza) and new matcha ingredients arriving next week.
